title: The Counter That Lies (Stale Closure)
brief: A counter component increments once from 0 to 1 and then freezes. Fix the stale closure bug.
symptoms: Counter increments to 1 upon mount, then stops counting
Interval callback captures initial count state variable in stale scope closure
Console shows no runtime error

hints.title: Analyze closure state capture
hints.content: The useEffect hook executes once on mount. The setInterval callback closes over the value of count at that moment (0).

hints.title: Functional State Updates
hints.content: Using setCount(prev => prev + 1) guarantees access to the current state without adding count to the dependency array.

explanation: In React, functions created inside components capture state values from the render in which they were created. When an effect creates an interval with an empty dependency array, the interval callback always sees `count` as 0. Using functional state updates (`setCount(prev => prev + 1)`) passes the current state directly to the state updater, avoiding stale closures entirely.

testCases.name: State Updater Functionality
testCases.description: Verifies that state setter uses a functional callback rather than direct count variable reference.

testCases.name: Continuous Tick Execution
testCases.description: Verifies counter increments beyond 1 after multiple interval ticks.

title: The Jumping Hero Banner (CLS)
brief: Dynamic hero banner images load asynchronously and push lower layout elements down abruptly, causing a bad CLS score.
symptoms: Page layout shifts abruptly when image finishes downloading
Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) score exceeds recommended 0.1 threshold
Buttons move unexpectedly under user mouse cursor

hints.title: Reserve dimensional aspect ratio
hints.content: Browsers require explicit dimension ratios or placeholders to calculate box sizes before media assets finish loading.

hints.title: CSS aspect-ratio property
hints.content: Adding aspect-ratio: 16/9 with background fallback holds the exact layout space.

explanation: When an tag lacks explicit dimensions or an aspect-ratio container, the browser defaults its height to 0px until image metadata arrives. Once loaded, the browser reflows the entire page, shifting downstream content downwards. Reserving container dimensions using CSS `aspect-ratio` guarantees zero shift.

testCases.name: Zero Dimension Shift
testCases.description: Checks if container height remains identical before and after image load.

testCases.name: Aspect Ratio Specification
testCases.description: Ensures aspect-ratio or explicit height constraints are declared on the hero container.

title: The Slow Resizing Tab (Retained Event Listener)
brief: A window resize handler is registered inside useEffect without an unmount cleanup function, causing memory leaks.
symptoms: Memory usage steadily climbs every time user navigates to the route
Multiple duplicate window resize handlers trigger simultaneously on resize
Unmounted component references remain trapped in memory heap

hints.title: Effect Lifecycle Cleanups
hints.content: Return a function from useEffect to detach global window or document event listeners.

hints.title: Reference equality for handlers
hints.content: Ensure the handleResize function reference passed to removeEventListener matches the exact one attached during addEventListener.

explanation: Global objects like `window` outlive React component lifecycles. Adding an event listener to `window` inside `useEffect` creates a persistent reference to the component instance. Without removing the listener upon component unmount, garbage collection is prevented and listeners accumulate infinitely on subsequent mounts.

testCases.name: EventListener Detachment
testCases.description: Verifies that window.removeEventListener is invoked with matching handler on component unmount.

testCases.name: Heap Garbage Collection
testCases.description: Confirms listener count resets to zero when navigating away.

title: Out-of-Order Search Results (Network Race)
brief: Rapid search input displays stale results from earlier, slower network responses instead of the latest search query.
symptoms: Typing 'React' shows results for 'Rea' because query 'Rea' took longer to respond
Network waterfall shows out-of-order response completions
UI search state mismatches actual input field value

hints.title: AbortController API
hints.content: Create an AbortController inside the effect and abort it in the effect cleanup return function.

hints.title: Ignore AbortError
hints.content: Catch errors in fetch promise chain and filter out expected 'AbortError' exceptions.

explanation: Network responses arrive asynchronously; latency varies per query. If a user types 'a' then 'ab', the request for 'a' may take 500ms while 'ab' takes 100ms. Without cancellation, response 'a' arrives last and overwrites response 'ab'. Using `AbortController` or boolean flags inside `useEffect` discards stale network responses.

testCases.name: Abort Signal Attachment
testCases.description: Verifies AbortController signal is passed into fetch request options.

testCases.name: Inflight Abort Execution
testCases.description: Verifies controller.abort() is called when query changes prior to completion.

title: Unlabeled Icon Buttons & Focus Leak (Accessibility)
brief: Icon-only buttons lack accessible names for screen readers, and custom popovers fail keyboard focus control.
symptoms: Screen readers announce 'button' with no descriptive text
Keyboard Tab navigation bypasses active drawer controls
Fails WCAG 2.1 Name, Role, Value (4.1.2) compliance
brokenCode:
/* ❌ Icon-only button with no screen reader label or aria-label */
<button className="p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-accent">
  <TrashIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
</button>
fixedCode: /* ✅ Accessible button with aria-label and visually hidden fallback text */

hints.title: Provide accessible labels
hints.content: Use aria-label or sr-only span elements to give icon buttons an accessible text name.

hints.title: Hide decorative SVG icons
hints.content: Mark SVG icons with aria-hidden='true' so screen readers don't read raw SVG path vectors.

explanation: Screen reader users rely on accessible names generated from element text content, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby`. An icon-only `<button>` containing solely an `<svg>` tag has no text, causing screen readers to output uninformative names like 'button' or 'unlabeled'.

testCases.name: Accessible Name Check
testCases.description: Verifies button element contains aria-label or .sr-only accessible text string.

testCases.name: Decorative Icon Suppression
testCases.description: Verifies embedded SVG icons carry aria-hidden='true'.

title: The Laggy Product Data Grid (Unmemoized Callbacks)
brief: Passing new object literals and unmemoized callbacks into list items causes 500+ child components to re-render on every keystroke.
symptoms: Typing in filter search box produces noticeable keystroke latency (>100ms)
React DevTools Profiler shows all 500 list items re-rendering on every key press
CPU profiling indicates excessive reconciliation overhead

hints.title: Reference equality in props
hints.content: Inline function expressions () => ... create a brand new function reference on every render, invalidating child memoization.

hints.title: useCallback & useMemo
hints.content: Wrap event handlers in useCallback and derived filter calculations in useMemo.

explanation: Components wrapped in `React.memo` skip rendering only if all props retain shallow equality (`===`). Passing inline object literals (`style={{...}}`) or inline callbacks (`() => ...`) creates fresh references on every parent render, forcing every child component to re-render unnecessarily.

testCases.name: Callback Reference Stability
testCases.description: Confirms handler callback reference remains stable across filter state updates.

testCases.name: Re-render Threshold Optimization
testCases.description: Verifies child component render count drops from 500+ to zero for unaffected rows.

title: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
brief: Accessing array methods on asynchronous state before initial fetch completes triggers a blank screen runtime crash.
symptoms: White screen crash on initial page load before API resolves
Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
App breaks unless state is initialized or guarded with optional chaining

hints.title: Default state initialization
hints.content: Initialize array state with useState([]) or default parameter values.

hints.title: Optional chaining & Nullish fallback
hints.content: Use (data ?? []).map(...) or data?.map(...) to safely evaluate potentially undefined data.

explanation: React components render synchronously prior to asynchronous `useEffect` execution. When `useState()` is initialized without parameters, `data` is `undefined` on the first render pass. Calling `.map()` on `undefined` causes JavaScript to throw an uncaught `TypeError` and unmount the component tree.

testCases.name: Initial Render Guard
testCases.description: Verifies component renders gracefully without error during initial loading phase.

testCases.name: Safe Collection Iteration
testCases.description: Confirms array mapping succeeds safely when data arrives or is empty.

title: Broken React App: The Uncapped Re-render Storm
brief: Updating state directly inside an un-guarded useEffect dependency array creates an infinite render cycle that freezes the browser.
symptoms: Browser tab freezes or crashes with 'Too many re-renders. React limits the number of renders'
CPU usage spikes to 100%
Network request spam or exponential state updates

hints.title: Dependency array mutation loop
hints.content: Updating a state variable inside useEffect while including that same variable in the dependency array causes an endless loop.

hints.title: Functional updater & empty deps
hints.content: Use functional state updates setSettings(prev => ...) and remove the state object from the effect dependencies.

explanation: Every time `setSettings` executes, React creates a new object reference. Because `settings` is listed in `useEffect`'s dependency array, React detects a change (`oldObject !== newObject`) and re-runs the effect immediately, triggering `setSettings` again in an infinite loop.

testCases.name: Bounded Render Cycle
testCases.description: Verifies component render count remains stable and does not exceed maximum update depth.

testCases.name: Dependency Array Optimization
testCases.description: Ensures state setters inside effects do not depend on mutated object references.
